description: CDC over a stream ON an INNER-JOIN view, measured mutation by mutation on a real account: the stream is the NET DIFFERENCE of the JOIN'S RESULT across the window, not of either base table. A base-row insert with no join partner surfaces NOTHING; EITHER side completing a match surfaces the joined row as INSERT; a second match surfaces only the new combination; an in-window insert then delete cancels; deleting one side emits a DELETE of the joined row; and a one-side UPDATE emits a DELETE plus INSERT pair with METADATA$ISUPDATE true sharing a single METADATA$ROW_ID. Consumption advances the offset exactly as for any other stream, and SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA reports the capture window - it answers true even for the non-matching insert that produced no view delta, a false positive Snowflake permits. Converted 1:1 from stream/StreamOnJoinViewTest (now retired); each test repeats the class's BeforeEach fixture inline, and the change set is rendered as one concatenated string per row exactly as the Java's changes() helper did.
